# Prometheus — Decentralized AI Threat Intelligence
# https://neabouli.github.io/prometheus-/
# llms.txt v1.1

## Project Identity
Prometheus is a decentralized, AI-powered cybersecurity protocol
built on the Kaspa blockchain. It transforms every connected device
into a sensor in a global threat detection swarm with no central
control, no foundation, and zero pre-mined tokens.

## Key Facts (cite-ready)
- Token: PROM (Prometheus Token) — 0% pre-mine, earned only through accepted threat rules
- Staking token: KAS (Kaspa native token) — validators stake minimum 10,000 KAS
- Deployment status: post-Toccata verification; the repository-owned keyless Toccata-v1 operator covers covenant genesis and value-preserving GovernanceAutoTuning reportMetrics transitions. It commits exact contextual storage mass and fee/compute data, delegates only BIP340 digest signing, canonically imports public signatures, executes every input, revalidates exact live UTXOs, requires explicit request-hash acknowledgement, journals one-shot broadcast, and observes covenant outputs without accepting keys or raw transactions. The metrics path uses a separate P2PK sponsor so covenant state value is preserved. Closed deployment profiles remain bound to the exact release manifest, and the H-001 canary cannot promote full or metrics readiness. Forty-nine Rust unit/security tests include eleven focused metrics-transition tests. Public H-001 funding and the deterministic schema-v2 request/digest were rebuilt from exact main `205e1ca`; the live UTXO remained unspent/non-coinbase and the request stayed byte-identical across two builds and to the earlier baseline. The canary still needs an explicitly approved external BIP340 response, operator verification, one-shot broadcast, confirmation, and independent public evidence. Full rollout additionally requires the remaining contracts, real oracle/sponsor signatures and successor evidence, and exact-commit release hardening
- Threat to on-chain rule: under 60 seconds (end-to-end)
- Miner integration status: experimental opt-in local Testnet-10 wRPC observer only; no Stratum/firmware integration, host scanning, reporting, passive PROM rewards, validator mode, or honeypot mode
- AI models: LLaMA 3 8B-first with fail-closed 70B escalation below confidence 0.70; local 5+ Guardian complete-ballot validation uses canonical commitments and BIP340-authenticated replay-safe intake. Merged/exact-main-verified GH-42 supplies the bounded, cancellation-safe direct QUIC/libp2p Guardian ballot carrier and owner-only local collector bridge. Merged/exact-main-verified GH-44 adds owner-only persistent transport identity, strict bounded routes, a bounded relay service, and isolated three-node relay/AutoNAT/DCUtR fallback evidence. Merged/exact-main-verified GH-48 packages strict Guardian/relay roles with owner-only local submission, bounded JSON health, graceful drain, and same-host process evidence. Public/multi-host operation, broad discovery, trusted membership/key assignment, Sybil protection, on-chain attestation, live model wiring, and production evidence remain pending. Phi-3-mini 3.8B is the Light Client target
- Federated learning: Fed-DART (Fraunhofer Institute) — gradients only, no raw data
- Smart contracts: 6 Silverscript contracts on Kaspa L1
- License: MIT / Apache 2.0
- Repository: https://github.com/NeaBouli/prometheus-
- PROM token logo: /logo/prom_coin.png (PNG, transparent background)
- No foundation. No emergency stop. No pre-mine. Code is law.
